summary: Session 1 of 3 (Config Save/Load, Module 17) complete. Built cnb/ui/config-io.js: JSON save with configName-derived filename (slug + .cnb.json, throws on underivable names) and plan 4.11 timestamp stamping (created on first save only, modified every save, host adopts the stamped config via onSave); load via parseConfigFile -> CNBConfig.merge over createDefault -> validate, with open-keyed map sections (shapes, lineOverrides, schemeSymbols, repeatCounts, keys.offKeyMark) replaced when provided as plain objects so save->load round-trips deep-equal. Loading never blocks on validation (export blocking is Module 18); malformed files are surfaced and leave app state untouched. 34 unit tests (498 total CNB, 240 legacy, all passing); test page hosts Module 15 + Module 17 on one shared config object; checked-in Playwright UAT driver 19/19 checks (edit -> save with real download capture -> reload -> load -> editor reflects reloaded state; second-save created preservation; malformed load). Verification: round 1 ISSUES_FOUND (scope adjudication, stale filename preview after load — fixed with callback-before-redraw + regression test, activity log count correction); round 2 VERIFIED.
